## Why

*Proposed.* A local model does not keep the note's anchor log while it explores (trials 3 and 5). The approval hook (`internal/agent/claude/pretool.go`, `Evaluate`) sees every Read (path, offset, limit) and Grep (pattern, path) a claude-local role makes, so ork can write the log itself.

Owner decisions (2026-11-16), both answered:

- Q1 (`roles.local-read-log-content`): one line per Read (`path:start-end`) and per Grep (`pattern in path`), calls only, no hit counts (the hook does not see results). Identical entries merge, newest last, at most 80 lines.
- Q2 (`roles.local-read-log-reuse`): the restart brief says "You already read these; do not read them again unless you are about to edit that range."
